title: Wire local evaluation dispatch progress into dashboard proof
description: Implement the approved local proof behavior from `plx-ab71e2`: local polling subscriptions must observe task/task-stage changes, and feedback evaluation commands must use the dispatcher-provided task context for progress tracking. Preserve the existing evaluation-record creation model. Validate with focused tests and a physical local dashboard run.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Opened two focused implementation PRs. #551 makes feedback evaluation inherit `PLEXUS_DISPATCH_TASK_ID`, so its existing progress tracker attaches stages to the task the dispatcher claimed. #552 replaces the local adapter no-op subscriptions with bounded polling subscriptions; production retains its native subscription transport. Validation: feedback integration tests (15 passed), local Amplify subscription tests (5 passed), dashboard TypeScript check, and diff checks. Physical browser proof follows after both merge into develop.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Merged #551 and #552 and completed a physical browser proof against the local control plane: a feedback evaluation moved through Setup, Processing, Analyzing, and Complete without reload; all 200 items completed and the task ended successfully. The remaining stderr presentation is tracked separately as plx-f7e6da.
